status: draft, written before the v2 Gold/p50c pilot generations were scored (only generator-level non-agent baselines had been computed); superseded by protocol_v2_frozen.json
benchmark: configs/phaseD_v2/benchmark_v2.json (split plan); generators code/wse/pd2_bench.py, pd2_mlp.py, pd2_policy.py, pd2_algo.py

families.F4: MinAtar policy behaviour (Seaquest/Asterix exp5 hand networks)

tiers.T0: select 1 of 4 complete edits; 4 rotations per instance, oracle once at each position, 1 sample per rotation (seed = rotation)
tiers.T1: subtype named, oracle template with numbers blanked; constrained to the template regex; n = 4, seed 0
tiers.T2: free-form DSL edit constrained to the instance DSL regex (1-12 statements); n = 4, seed 0
tiers.T2P: T2 with one budgeted probe pass: trial edit (n = 4, seed 0) -> probe-set feedback -> final edit (n = 1 per trial, seed 1); probe passes counted

decoding.prefix_cache: reset before every generate() call (makes sampled outputs bit-reproducible run to run)

engine.default: profile3 (FLASHINFER, max_num_seqs 1024, max_num_batched_tokens 16384, BF16, max_model_len 32768, gpu_memory_utilization 0.85)

scoring.recovery: (metric(edited) - metric(damaged)) / (metric(clean) - metric(damaged)) on the instance test set
scoring.invalid: invalid or missing edits are scored as no-ops (recovery 0) and reported separately as invalid

cell_acceptance_rule.unit: family x tier cell, core families F1-F4, decided on the pilot split
criteria: oracle mean recovery >= 0.90 (the reference repair is achievable)
headroom over the trivial non-agent repairer: simple-heuristic mean recovery <= 0.60 (for T0 additionally: chance <= 0.40)
Gold E0 is not at ceiling: E0 mean recovery <= 0.80
format is not the bottleneck: E0 valid rate >= 0.50
cell_acceptance_rule.floor_cells: cells where E0 mean recovery <= 0.02 are kept but flagged (improvement must come from candidates)
cell_acceptance_rule.reporting: the improved (probe-search) heuristic is reported as the stronger non-agent reference; it is not an acceptance criterion

primary_endpoint: paired mean recovery difference candidate - E0 over accepted cells on the test split (pairing: instance x tier x sample), instance-cluster bootstrap CI, Holm correction across candidates
secondary: transfer split (held-out F1-F4 subtypes and the F5 family)
per-family/tier recovery, valid, effective, regression rates
resource-normalized recovery per 1k generated tokens and per GPU-second
heldout_access: test/transfer seeds use a secret salt (work/benchmarks/phaseD-v2/secret_salt.txt, sha256 committed); the evaluator refuses held-out splits without --allow-heldout; parent sessions receive dev-split material only
